title: Structural Constraints on Entropy-Gradient Gravity from Cluster Merger Geometry
abstract: Reproducible constraint study testing whether Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) entropy-gradient formulations can reproduce Bullet Cluster lensing geometry without particle dark matter. The paper falsifies purely local gradient couplings (0/42 pass) and shows that a non-local, component-sensitive response with L0≈200 kpc and strong collisionless weighting (w≈20) can conditionally match the observed mass–gas separation, yielding falsifiable a priori predictions for MACS J0025 and Abell 520.
